modifications: Derived from the catalogue's published table by dropping its three FTP URL columns (ftp_path, ftp_cs_path, ftp_lbf_path) and adding file_class, READ off the published ftp_path file name ('all' or 'cc'), never inferred from quant_method. Every other value is byte-identical to the source. The three URLs are reconstructed from study_id, dataset_id and file_class by the skill; reconstruction was asserted equal to the source on 758 of 758 rows for all three families at derivation time.
why_derived: ClawBio's wheel build hook (hatch_build.py, SMALL_DATA_MAX_BYTES = 262144) drops non-headline skill data files over 256 KB; the source table is 287,387 bytes.
why_bundled: The catalogue's metadata REST API was permanently disabled in September 2026; the maintainer confirmed it on our issue, https://github.com/eQTL-Catalogue/eQTL-Catalogue-resources/issues/59 (closed 2026-09-09). This table is the metadata route in its place.
licence_note: The eQTL Catalogue licence page states, in one sentence covering both halves: "All eQTL Catalogue code is distributed under Apache 2.0 license and all its data is distributed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License" (read verbatim 2026-08-20). This table is DATA -- dataset metadata published by the project -- so CC-BY-4.0 with attribution. The GitHub repository that publishes it holds data tables and scripts and carries no LICENSE file of its own, but the licensor has assigned a licence to BOTH categories, so no content in that repository is unlicensed. Approved for this use by the project owner on 2026-08-19.

MODIFICATIONS: this file is DERIVED from the source table, not a copy of it -- see the modifications field above (three FTP URL columns dropped, file_class added from the published file name; every other value byte-identical). The sha256 above is of THIS derived file; source_sha256 is of the retrieved source bytes.
per_study_attribution: This file carries NO pmid column (its 10 columns are study_id, dataset_id, study_label, sample_group, tissue_id, tissue_label, condition_label, sample_size, quant_method, file_class; the source's three FTP URL columns are dropped, as stated above), so it cannot by itself discharge per-study attribution to each dataset's original publication. What supplies that: (a) study_label, present and non-empty on all 758 rows, is the author-year handle of the original publication and is what rides into rendered output; (b) the PMID itself lives in the sibling table data_tables/dataset_metadata_r7.tsv in the same repository, which covers exactly the same 758 dataset ids with a pmid column that is non-empty on all 758 (verified 2026-08-19). That sibling is deliberately NOT vendored here, because nothing on the fetch path reads it; a caller needing PMIDs should join against it rather than expect them in this artifact.
release_keyed: Keyed to eQTL Catalogue r7; listed in docs/research/data_source_upgrade_derived_artifacts.md. An r8 bump re-derives this table with scripts/research/derive_eqtl_dataset_index_slim.py, which re-asserts the reconstruction; the 0-mismatch result is an r7 measurement.
